SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema IN ('store','warehouse','payments')
  AND (column_name ~* 'cash|operator|employee|user|staff|till|supplier|vendor|payable|credit|term|due|ledger|account|cashier|owner')
ORDER BY 1,2,ordinal_position;

SELECT date_trunc('day', bill_ts)::date d, sku_scanned, unit_price, count(*) n, sum(qty) qty
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned LIKE 'ATTA%'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,1,3;

SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.pack, p.price_inr, p.cost_inr, p.flow,
       ds.units, ds.rev, ds.rev - ds.units*p.cost_inr AS gross_profit,
       ds.rev - ds.units*p.cost_inr - coalesce(wo.wo_units,0)*p.cost_inr AS gp_after_wo,
       coalesce(wo.wo_units,0) wo_units, coalesce(sa.empty_cnt,0) empty_audits,
       coalesce(sc.adj_units,0) adj_units, coalesce(ib.close_qty,0) close_qty
FROM store.products p
JOIN (SELECT sku, sum(units_sold) units, sum(revenue_inr) rev FROM store.daily_sales
      WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1) ds ON ds.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sku, sum(units) wo_units FROM store.write_offs
           WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1) wo ON wo.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sku, count(*) empty_cnt FROM store.shelf_audits
           WHERE status='empty' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1) sa ON sa.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sku, sum(adjustment) adj_units FROM store.stock_counts
           WHERE count_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND count_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1) sc ON sc.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sku, book_on_hand_close close_qty FROM store.inventory_book
           WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM store.inventory_book)) ib ON ib.sku=p.sku
ORDER BY gp_after_wo;

SELECT left(bill_id, 12) pfx, count(*) n, min(bill_ts)::text mn, max(bill_ts)::text mx
FROM store.pos_lines GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 40;

SELECT n.nspname schema, c.relname obj, c.relkind kind
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','pg_toast')
  AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','f','p')
ORDER BY 1,2;

WHERE bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-03'

SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM payments.customer_complaints
   WHERE complaint_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND complaint_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS complaints_june,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM payments.customer_complaints
   WHERE complaint_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND complaint_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
     AND kind ILIKE '%pay%' OR (complaint_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND complaint_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND kind IN ('charged twice','debited but the till said failed'))) AS complaints_payment_kinds,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE status='empty' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS empty_audit_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT sku) FROM store.daily_sales) AS skus_daily_sales,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT sku_scanned) FROM store.pos_lines) AS skus_pos_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM store.products) AS products_master;

SELECT

**Answer:** *Drop / review:* **MILK-FC-500ML** (5.0% margin, 198 units written off = 6.8% of units sold, 63 stock-count adjustments, 6 days negative book stock) and **MILK-TONED-500ML** (5.0% margin, 296 units expired/damaged, 81 negative adjustments) — both DSD milks destroy margin and stock. **ATTA-WW-5KG** needs fixing rather than dropping (2 empty shelf audits, 3 damaged write-offs, −64 stock adjustments, 1 zero-stock day). **SUGAR-1KG** and **CURD-500G** are watch-list (1 empty audit / 2 zero-stock days). *Add:* the records contain **no candidate/new-product data** (no assortment, demand or supplier-catalog table), so no additions can be named; all 11 listed SKUs sold in June, so nothing is a zero-sales delisting candidate.
**Confidence:** Medium-high on the drop list (June margin, write-off, shrink and shelf data are complete for 1–28 June); no basis at all for additions.
